data.promptProse: Viewed from a slightly low close angle in a locked occult clubroom at night, Ayachi Nene sits on the edge of the worn dark sofa leaning intimately forward toward the viewer. She wears her canonical witch outfit—pointed hat with pink-striped ribbon, pink-lined black cape, criss-cross halter crop top with loosened straps, black pleated miniskirt, and asymmetrical striped thighhighs—resting both hands lightly on her own knees while her cheeks burn crimson and tears shimmer in her purple eyes beneath unsteady warm candlelight.
data.story: 社办门落锁后，只剩书桌上几支摇曳的暖色蜡烛。穿着魔女服的宁宁跨坐到你膝上，发烫的指尖轻轻抵住你的胸口，雾蒙蒙的紫眸里满是克制不住的依恋——「不用再忍耐了……既然是你帮我守住的秘密，今晚也全部交给你好不好？」
